# Add Discount Plan

## Context
Checkout needs a percentage discount applied before tax.

## Acceptance
A cart with a discount code shows the reduced total in the browser.
files.src/checkout.ts: export function total(items, discount) { return items.reduce((a, i) => a + i.price, 0) * (1 - discount); }
